text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion. This is Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By achieving results with the "Fire and Water Unification"
I learned from the Kongo Yaegaki style,
I intend to repay my grandparents for everything.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, I look forward to receiving your continued guidance and encouragement. Osu!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
